scope: public reports only; raw report compressed unchanged; per-round database and signing journal retained locally; no private-key files

latency_us.definition: first native wire-frame submission attempt to slowest of four receipt-query observations; includes initial execution/consensus wait and bounded observer; not an internal finality timestamp

rounds.timing: same native load drive: first SDK submission attempt through every unique four-node receipt-query observation; startup/keygen/signing/structure preparation/untimed economics/cold recovery excluded

diagnostic_counters.scope: existing local process-lifetime tick snapshots including startup and post-load queries; nested/concurrent stage times are not additive critical-path shares; INCOMPLETE forbids complete attribution but does not alter economic assertions

nodes.phase_scope: process lifetime inclusive wall time; overlapping/nested phases; non-atomic snapshot; not CPU time or consensus evidence

native_io_costs.scope: current poll thread; lifetime inclusive sampled wall time; nested phases are not additive; not CPU time

traffic.scope: current thread; wire_sent/received and blocked are immediate UDP only; sealed/authenticated include bound carriers; bytes include secure envelope, exclude IP/UDP headers; blocked/deferred bytes are attempts, NOT sent bytes; stages overlap, do not sum stages

successor.scope: same local-or-remote successor owner; early body counters are logical peer enqueue obligations/bytes, not wire delivery or retransmission

archive_work.scope: original archive read starts and same-context verified reply reuse; per-peer delivery remains independent, not wire completion
